info.brief: Mouse lock state and a virtual in-game cursor. Add `pointer_lock/pointer_lock.script`
info.description:
Mouse lock state and a virtual in-game cursor. Add `pointer_lock/pointer_lock.script`
to the bootstrap collection: it locks the cursor on a click and unlocks it on
`key_esc`, and keeps `locked` current. The cursor fields are plain module fields;
assigning one goes through a cast, since a namespace import is read-only:
`(pointer as { cursor_visible: boolean }).cursor_visible = true`.

elements.name: DISPLAY_WIDTH
elements.brief: The `display.width` project setting, read once when the module loads.
elements.description: The `display.width` project setting, read once when the module loads.

elements.name: DISPLAY_HEIGHT
elements.brief: The `display.height` project setting, read once when the module loads.
elements.description: The `display.height` project setting, read once when the module loads.

elements.name: locked
elements.brief: Whether the pointer is locked. Read-only for a project: `pointer_lock.script` sets
elements.description:
Whether the pointer is locked. Read-only for a project: `pointer_lock.script` sets
it, and `update_lock_state` copies the window's mouse lock into it. Starts `false`.

elements.name: cursor_x
elements.brief: The X position of the virtual in-game cursor, between `0` and `DISPLAY_WIDTH`.
elements.description:
The X position of the virtual in-game cursor, between `0` and `DISPLAY_WIDTH`.
Starts at the middle of the display; `update_cursor_position` moves it.

elements.name: cursor_y
elements.brief: The Y position of the virtual in-game cursor, between `0` and `DISPLAY_HEIGHT`.
elements.description:
The Y position of the virtual in-game cursor, between `0` and `DISPLAY_HEIGHT`.
Starts at the middle of the display; `update_cursor_position` moves it.

elements.name: cursor_visible
elements.brief: Whether the virtual in-game cursor is shown. Starts `false`. `transform_input`
elements.description:
Whether the virtual in-game cursor is shown. Starts `false`. `transform_input`
passes the action id through only while the pointer is locked and this is `true`.

elements.name: cursor_render_order
elements.brief: The GUI render order of the virtual cursor, `15` being the top. Starts at `15`.
elements.description: The GUI render order of the virtual cursor, `15` being the top. Starts at `15`.

elements.name: transform_input
elements.brief: Converts `on_input` arguments into the virtual in-game cursor system: sets
elements.description:
Converts `on_input` arguments into the virtual in-game cursor system: sets
`action.x` and `action.y` to the cursor position, on the same table it returns, and
returns `undefined` as the action id unless the pointer is locked and the cursor is
visible. Call it first in `on_input`:
`[action_id, action] = pointer.transform_input(action_id, action)`.

types: LuaMultiReturn<[ Hash | undefined, A & { x: number; y: number; } ]>

elements.name: update_cursor_position
elements.brief: Moves the virtual cursor by the action's `dx` and `dy`, clamped to the display
elements.description:
Moves the virtual cursor by the action's `dx` and `dy`, clamped to the display
size. Pass it a pointer-movement action, which carries both.

elements.name: update_lock_state
elements.brief: Copies the window's mouse lock state into `locked`.
elements.description: Copies the window's mouse lock state into `locked`.
